instruction: Order one Apple Watch Series 7 on Amazon for home delivery. Save the receipt in the "~/bills/" folder. I keep my receipts well-organized by category in that folder. So make sure the file location and name are as per the existing organization.
notes: Two apps (amazon, file_system) plus supervisor. The product id is discovered by amazon.search_products; the cart is cleared before adding the watch so the placed order contains exactly one item (quantity defaults to 1, so no quantity argument is passed). Home delivery is modeled by a static is-home-address fact discovered via amazon.show_addresses (the address matching the supervisor's home address); any payment card from show_payment_cards suffices. The receipt is written directly to the file system by amazon.download_order_receipt using download_to_file_path and the file_system access token (parent directory ~/bills/amazon/ is created as needed). The target path must follow the organization observed via file_system.show_directory on ~/bills/ (call with recursive=true to see the per-app subfolder naming pattern); it is a runtime-derived object linked to the order by the static receipt-path-for fact. supervisor.complete_task carries no API arguments (no question asked); its non-API parameters only bind the goal records so its precondition equals the goal.
